preconditions.description: The input string must be exactly 5 characters long, formatted as HH:MM.
The input string must contain a colon separating the hours and minutes.
The hours and minutes must be numeric characters.
The hour part of the input must be a number between 00 and 23, inclusive.
The minute part of the input must be a number between 00 and 59, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The function must return a number of minutes till the next bus, which will be between 0 and 15, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: result == 0 or result == 15 or result == 30 or result == 45
postconditions.description: The function must return a number that is a multiple of 15, indicating the next bus time.
The function must return 0 if the current time is within 5 minutes of the next bus, or a multiple of 15 minutes if it is not.
